lessons.claim: When fixing dt, **leaving out even one candidate timescale makes it quietly insufficient**. In chain-bend-2d-dlvo, τ_fast was set as min(τ_bond, τ_bend) and **the trap's τ_k was left out** -- at the default k_t, k_bond (1.04e6) dominates so it never surfaced, but around --kt-scale 200 the trap becomes the fastest mode while dt stayed as it was. The DLVO branch was more dangerous still, having no bending matrix so τ_bend is None. Measured after fixing: kt×1 and ×100 keep dt=59ns, ×300 gives 39ns and ×1000 shrinks automatically to 11.8ns. → When adding a flag that scales a parameter, always confirm **whether that parameter is among the dt candidates**.
